threat_event: Memory-scraping malware on AC legacy POS captures card data at the 160 AC stores
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy PIN pads do not encrypt at the point of interaction; card data in clear text in POS memory and on flat store networks; legacy remote support tool with shared credentials; no EDR or SIEM feed
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-13 AC legacy POS (about 2.9 million card transactions a year); BP-16
regulatory_driver: N81-R03 (PCI DSS v4.0.1 1.3; 3.3; 4.2; 5.2; 8.4); N81-R02 (state breach laws); SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05
existing_controls: Interim access lists on AC store firewalls (2026-02); legacy processor fraud monitoring; weekly external scans
treatment_plan: Convert AC stores to P2PE and the STPP in two waves; interim: remove the legacy remote tool, EDR on AC POS PCs, card data VLAN, SIEM feed (POAM-001; POAM-002; POAM-012)
key_risk_indicator: AC stores converted; AC POS PCs with EDR; card data VLAN coverage

threat_event: Attacker with stolen workforce credentials bulk-exports STPP customer records, including passcode-like strings in notes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 212,000 tickets hold passcode-like strings in free-text notes and 1,140 hold card numbers; export detection relies on volume thresholds
existing_controls: SSO with MFA; role scoping per location; bulk export alerts; restricted passcode field purged at release
treatment_plan: Purge passcode and card-number strings from notes and block new entries (POAM-003); atypical-use analytics (POAM-005)
key_risk_indicator: Tickets with passcode strings in notes; bulk export alerts per month

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts store, depot, and enterprise systems across multiple regions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large attack surface (1,120 stores, 14,500 endpoints); AC gaps (R-004); 9% of core bench workstations without EDR
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 to SYS-07; all tier-1 processes (P05)
regulatory_driver: N81-R02 (state breach laws); SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05; N81-BM (CSF 2.0 RC.RP)
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR on 97% of corporate endpoints; PAM; immutable backups; annual tier-1 DR tests; cyber insurance
treatment_plan: Close AC gaps (R-004); EDR on remaining bench workstations with the new image (POAM-005); annual ransomware exercise including the disclosure committee (POAM-008)
key_risk_indicator: EDR coverage; mean time to contain; tier-1 DR test results

threat_event: Attacker enters through an AC flat network or the legacy managed service provider's remote tool and reaches enterprise systems

treatment_plan: Remove the legacy remote tool and replace with PAM-brokered support; segment AC stores; convert to SD-WAN (POAM-002)
key_risk_indicator: AC stores segmented; legacy remote tool sessions per week

existing_controls: Named bench accounts; USB blocked except at data transfer stations; session recording at stations; CCTV; background checks
treatment_plan: New image with automatic cache wipe; periodic session log review; agreements re-signed; atypical-use analytics (POAM-005)
key_risk_indicator: Substantiated access complaints; workstations on the new image; agreements signed
